unlisted_practices: Coding AI counselor utterances with MITI and patient utterances with MISC to evaluate conversational processes of AI-delivered motivational interviewing
Using change talk balance as a process measure associated with post-session readiness to change

screen.reason: The study evaluates an AI conversational agent (GPT-4 based) deployed to emergency department patients with substance use issues to assess conversational MI fidelity, but it does not compare outcomes with vs without a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
